name: Scales of the Ibis
source:
You are a [s]scared[/s] sacred Ibis, in charge of keeping the universe in balance...
...Also your buddy is a cute frog!

But when Earth is on the brink of doom, men come to challenge the law you uphold: To obtain anything, something of equal value must be lost. There is NO exception. Ever.
...Also your other buddy is a sweet bonsai, celebrating her birthday!

But as the end of the world looms, the humans grow more desperate in their attempts to break the eternal law.
How far will mankind go to prevent the apocalypse and save their world?
And IF they succeed in breaking the law... what would happen to the universe as a whole?
...but anyway, don’t forget the birthday present for your bonsai friend!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4620380/Scales_of_the_Ibis/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你是一只[s]胆战心惊[/s]神圣庄严的圣䴉，肩负着维持整个宇宙平衡的重任……
……顺带一提，你的搭档是一只可爱的小青蛙！

然而当地球濒临毁灭之际，人类纷纷前来挑战你所捍卫的铁律：欲有所得，必先失去同等价值之物。绝无任何例外，永远如此。
……顺带一提，你的另一位搭档是一株甜美可爱的盆栽，今天正好过生日！

可随着世界末日步步逼近，绝望的人类愈发不顾一切地企图打破这条永恒法则。
为了阻止末日降临、拯救自己的世界，人类究竟愿意做到何种地步？
而倘若他们当真成功打破了法则……整个宇宙又将迎来怎样的后果？
……不过话说回来，可千万别忘了给你那位盆栽朋友准备生日礼物呀！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4620380/Scales_of_the_Ibis/]Steam[/url]]
